headline: Bhagiradha Chemicals publishes Q2 financial highlights
hook: Bhagiradha Chemicals releases Q2 financial presentation
summary: Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited has filed its investor presentation detailing financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The document provides a breakdown of the company's operational and financial metrics for the period. Retail investors can access these details on the NSE website to evaluate the company's recent growth and margin trends.
why_it_matters: Review company performance metrics to assess current operational health.

headline: Radhakishan Damani's top 10 stock holdings revealed
hook: Tracking the portfolio of a veteran investor
summary: Ace investor Radhakishan Damani's portfolio includes significant stakes in United Breweries, TSF Investments, and Horizon Industrial Parks. The list also features Blue Dart Express and Bhagiradha Chemicals among his top holdings by value. This disclosure provides retail investors insight into the asset allocation strategies of a prominent market participant.
why_it_matters: Provides insight into the investment strategy of a seasoned market veteran.
